prerequisites: Participation in the work of the Scientific Circle is possible after submitting a declaration of participation and confirmation of taking care of the project implemented by the student (group of students), by the Supervisor of the Circle or another employee of the Faculty. In the case of participation in the implementation of research work carried out at the Faculty, it is necessary to confirm the student's initial commitment to participate in the study, signed by an independent researcher.

learning_outcomes.text: Has the necessary general and specialist knowledge in mathematics, physics, mechanics, and specialist subjects necessary for the realization of a technical project.

Has knowledge about current development directions in power engineering, covering in particular problems of renewable energy, increasing the efficiency of electricity use, and the need to search for and apply innovative solutions in the economy and everyday life.

Has the ability to work effectively in a team to achieve a common goal, which is the successful solution of the problems facing it. Can obtain information from various sources, prepare technical documentation, and perform all tasks in cooperation with other team members, taking into account the requirements for effective teamwork and occupational health and safety.
Possesses skills allowing for the practical execution of projects that are the implementation of modern electrotechnical constructions, in accordance with good engineering knowledge and practice.

Understands the need for continuous self-improvement, is aware of the importance of non-technical aspects of engineering activity and its impact on the environment. Is aware of their own responsibility for the results of the work of the team implementing innovative engineering projects.

syllabus_topics: Realization of an independent or team scientific project under the supervision of a scientific supervisor.
Preparation of the report and presentation on the completed project.
Presentation of project results at a seminar or scientific conference.
teaching_methods: Participation in a student research club

assessment_methods.method: Involvement in a student research group

assessment_rules: The condition for obtaining credit is active participation in the work of the Scientific Circle under the care of the Supervisor or another academic employee of the Faculty, or active participation in other scientific research conducted at the Faculty. The grade is determined by the level of active participation: 3.0 for active participation in the preparation of a selected project, 3.5 for active participation and a partial report, 4.0 for active participation and partial and final reports, 4.5 for active participation, partial and final reports, and presentation of results, and 5.0 for active participation, project preparation, and presentation of results at a scientific conference or in a journal scored by the Ministry of Science and Higher Education. There is no formal requirement for presence at regular classes, but systematic work on the project or participation in studies is required.
